subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram provider intermittently stalls despite stable direct Bot API connectivity

question: Should maintainers sponsor a shared scheme-aware proxy fix now, or wait for redacted live Telegram SOCKS5 proof before deciding the proxy contract change?
rationale: The source and Undici contract make the SOCKS proxy failure plausible, but the current candidate also changes compatibility-sensitive shared proxy behavior and still lacks inspectable live Telegram proxy proof.

options.title: Sponsor shared proxy repair
options.body: Proceed with a maintainer-owned or replacement fix that covers explicit and env proxy modes with tests and live proof before landing.

options.title: Wait for live proof
options.body: Keep this issue open but require a current-main SOCKS5 getMe/sendMessage transcript before any proxy contract change is accepted.

options.title: Treat as configuration support
options.body: Do not change shared proxy behavior unless a new report proves OpenClaw-specific failure beyond documented proxy/DNS configuration.

recommendation.title: Sponsor shared proxy repair
recommendation.body: Proceed with a maintainer-owned or replacement fix that covers explicit and env proxy modes with tests and live proof before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest shared proxy-helper history and is already connected to this issue's timeline.
